using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Duplicati.Library
{
    public class OAuthHttpMessageHandler : DelegatingHandler
    {
        private readonly string m_authid;
        private readonly string m_protocolKey;
        private readonly string m_oauthurl;

        public OAuthHttpMessageHandler(string authid, string protocolKey, string oauthurl)
        {
            this.m_authid = authid;
            this.m_protocolKey = protocolKey;
            this.m_oauthurl = oauthurl;
        }

        protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // Authenticate the request
            var authenticatedRequest = await this.AuthenticateRequestAsync(request, cancellationToken);

            // Send the authenticated request
            return await base.SendAsync(authenticatedRequest, cancellationToken);
        }

        private async Task<HttpRequestMessage> AuthenticateRequestAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // Authenticate the request using OAuth
            var authenticationToken = await this.GetAuthenticationTokenAsync(cancellationToken);
            request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", authenticationToken);

            return request;
        }

        private async Task<string> GetAuthenticationTokenAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // Get the authentication token using OAuth
            var tokenResponse = await this.GetTokenResponseAsync(cancellationToken);
            return tokenResponse.AccessToken;
        }

        private async Task<TokenResponse> GetTokenResponseAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // Get the token response using OAuth
            var tokenRequest = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, this.m_oauthurl);
            tokenRequest.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Basic", Convert.ToBase64String(System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes($"{this.m_authid}:{this.m_protocolKey}")));
            tokenRequest.Content = new StringContent("grant_type=client_credentials", System.Text.Encoding.UTF8, "application/x-www-form-urlencoded");

            var tokenResponse = await this.SendTokenRequestAsync(tokenRequest, cancellationToken);
            return tokenResponse;
        }

        private async Task<TokenResponse> SendTokenRequestAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // Send the token request
            var response = await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

            // Parse the token response
            var tokenResponse = await response.Content.ReadAsAsync<TokenResponse>();
            return tokenResponse;
        }

        public HttpRequestMessage PreventAuthentication(HttpRequestMessage request)
        {
            // Prevent authentication from being applied on the given request
            request.Headers.Authorization = null;
            return request;
        }
    }

    public class TokenResponse
    {
        public string AccessToken { get; set; }
        public string TokenType { get; set; }
        public int ExpiresIn { get; set; }
    }
}
